properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured on 0.77.0): no served read returns one node's edges as edges. get_node returns properties only. propagate_from at max_depth 1 is the nearest: it gave 6 of the 7 edges on a test node (it dropped AUTHORED_BY), with impact direction rather than edge direction and no evidence. topic_report gives counts per edge type, and only export_graph is complete. find_tools surfaces none of these for the report's wording, and the lesson naming the workaround rides only get_node's tools/list description
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-10-02, triage agent B. Item L19 of art:vscode-call-door-field-report-2026-10-02, "No edge reader. get_node takes no edges option, and find_tools does not surface a neighbours tool". The report's working pattern was to read the export.

② PRECEDENT: fact:an-absence-claim-about-why-a-node-changed-read-only-the-node-and-missed-its-retiring-decision-2026-09-28 met the same gap in-session, wrote a false absence claim, and hung its lesson on get_node ("read the node's connections (topic_report, or propagate_from depth 1)"). No Decision or Requirement proposes an edge reader; Decision and Requirement searches for "a node's edges / neighbours" found none.

⑤ MEASURED on a scratch import of main's export, node req:a-lesson-is-served-at-the-step-it-concerns. The export holds 7 edges on it: AUTHORED_BY, 2× DEPENDS_ON, EVOLVES_INTO, SATISFIES, SCHEDULED_FOR, VERIFIES.
- get_node: properties only. Its schema takes only {id, node_type}.
- propagate_from {seed_ids:[id], max_depth:1}: direct_ring lists 6 neighbours with edge_type and `direction`. AUTHORED_BY is missing. `direction` is the IMPACT direction (downstream / lateral / causal), not the stored from→to, and no edge property (evidence) is shown.
- topic_report: `connections` gives a COUNT per edge type and direction for each hit, with no neighbour ids, and it is keyed by words, not by id.
- relation_candidates: `already_related` lists review-relation neighbours by id only.
- export_graph: the only complete reader, and it costs the whole design.
- None of the 195 tool descriptions says "returns a node's edges / neighbours".

find_tools rank for the report's own phrase, "read one node by id with its properties and edges": get_node 8th, propagate_from 14th, relation_candidates 29th, export_graph 149th. The default limit is 5, so none is shown. For "show a node's neighbours", propagate_from is 5th.

⑥ CLASS: the graph's edges, which are what the design IS, have no per-node read. Each partial reader was built for another job (impact, topic, linking), so its description names that job, and find_tools, which ranks descriptions, cannot map "edges of a node" to any of them. Through the door, the one lesson that names the workaround is invisible (fact:root-cause-tool-lessons-reach-only-tools-list-and-no-door-reply-carries-one-2026-10-02).

CONFIRMED, with one correction to the report: a partial edge reader does exist (propagate_from depth 1). It is just not findable, and it is not complete.
